scripts.build:registry: pnpm run registry:validate && pnpm run registry:clean && pnpm run registry:build && pnpm run registry:format
scripts.check:package:vue: node scripts/check-vue-declarations.mjs packages/vue && publint packages/vue && attw --pack packages/vue --exclude-entrypoints ./style.css ./reset.css ./presets/contrast.css ./presets/dense.css ./presets/soft.css --profile esm-only --ignore-rules internal-resolution-error
scripts.check:package:vue-tailwind: node scripts/check-vue-declarations.mjs packages/vue-tailwind && publint packages/vue-tailwind && attw --pack packages/vue-tailwind --exclude-entrypoints ./style.css './presets/*' --profile esm-only --ignore-rules internal-resolution-error
scripts.changeset:release: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run check:packages && changeset publish
scripts.publish:react: pnpm run build:react && pnpm run check:package:react && pnpm --filter @moduix/react publish
scripts.publish:react-tailwind: pnpm run build:react-tailwind && pnpm run check:package:react-tailwind && pnpm --filter @moduix/react-tailwind publish
scripts.publish:solid: pnpm run build:solid && pnpm run check:package:solid && pnpm --filter @moduix/solid publish
scripts.publish:solid-tailwind: pnpm run build:solid-tailwind && pnpm run check:package:solid-tailwind && pnpm --filter @moduix/solid-tailwind publish
scripts.publish:vue: pnpm run build:vue && pnpm run check:package:vue && pnpm --filter @moduix/vue publish
scripts.publish:vue-tailwind: pnpm run build:vue-tailwind && pnpm run check:package:vue-tailwind && pnpm --filter @moduix/vue-tailwind publish
